name: OpenCode Go
author: ardfard
description: OpenCode Go usage: subscription limit windows, per-model tokens and cost, day sparkline. Ignores other OpenCode providers.

barWidget.description: Click: Go limits and model breakdown. Middle/right click: force refresh.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to re-run the collector (local opencode-go rows + Go limit API).

schema.label: Usage window (days)
schema.description: How many days of OpenCode Go history feed the model ranking, cost total and sparkline.

schema.label: Max model rows
schema.description: How many models to show individually; the rest are folded into an "other" row.
